scope: Primary-source and Local-Wiki audit; no sampling, fit, threshold, decoder run, or new contraction.

target.requirement: A method must certify the public-charge-record l1 norm after the signed logical twist is pushed forward; scalar partition-function accuracy alone is insufficient.

candidates.established_target: scalar partition functions and sampling from a convergent contour representation
candidates.failed_interface: no convergent contour representation for the recordwise l1 functional

candidates.established_target: model-specific scalar partition functions under spatial-mixing or zero-free conditions
candidates.failed_interface: hard charge constraints and no control of sum_Q |A1(Q)|

candidates.established_target: positive-interaction marginals and scalar counting under a Birkhoff-contraction condition
candidates.failed_interface: incidence delta factors contain zeros and the emitted-record l1 norm is not a local marginal
absolute value over exponentially many charge coefficients is not the scalar analytic target

candidates.established_target: bond-dimension-controlled numerical approximation of fixed-record coset probabilities
candidates.failed_interface: no certified global error for the sum of recordwise sector minima

candidates.established_target: complexity of l1 distance between labelled Markov-chain output laws
candidates.failed_interface: not a reduction for this lattice, but demonstrates that tractable hidden propagation does not make output l1 tractable

candidates.established_target: monotone certified bounds converging to the same LER functional
candidates.failed_interface: physical R-to-1 record weighting is not supplied by the clean integer-replica R=2 model

selected_next_test.name: physical moment degree-versus-width feasibility
selected_next_test.inputs: exact L3 sector tables and already stored L5 record-level posteriors
selected_next_test.question: Can a low-order physical moment hierarchy give a useful interval in the ambiguous fair/intermediate regime before any replica-transfer implementation is attempted?
selected_next_test.claim_boundary: Diagnostic only; empirical L5 moments cannot become an analytic curve.
selected_next_test.stop_rule: If the registered width gate fails by N=32, close moment compression rather than derive an expensive transfer for an insufficient statistic.

decision: No reviewed scalar partition, correlation-decay, positive-polytope, or MPS theorem directly controls the LER public-record l1 norm. Retain only the physical moment hierarchy for one bounded no-new-sampling feasibility matrix.
